description: Registry of papers reproduced in this repository and how they relate to one another. This file is intentionally kept at the repository root (parallel to the individual paper folders), because it describes cross-paper relationships rather than the internals of any single paper.

schema.papers[].id: stable short identifier used in citation edges
schema.papers[].folder: path to the self-contained folder for this paper
schema.citations[]: directed edge {from, to}: paper `from` cites paper `to` (both are ids in papers[])

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: Introduces the Transformer, a sequence-to-sequence architecture based entirely on attention, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.
